race.comment: FIOROWNGOOD (2) stepped up to a middle distance for the first time to break his maiden status and then took the next step immediately at Donald by a nose last time out when paying juicy odds. He will relish stepping out to 2400m, and the hat-trick beckons, just don't expect another fancy price. EAGLE ANGEL (1) has recently joined the Shane Jackson stable at Warrnambool and is probably looking ahead to a jumping career. He has a strong record over 2400m, and it won't be long until he finds some good form again. Check the markets. HULA BEAT (4) did not have much go his way last time out here over 3150m and has been a late scratching since then. Stick with him. FUWARI (8) expect a form reversal in this. Top 4 value.
